points: \item Implemented machine learning models for brain-computer interface applications, improving neural decoder accuracy by ~20% and enabling faster control speed for individuals with paralysis to interact with computers and robotic arms.

\item Built time series analysis workflows for neural signal processing, enhancing relevance and coverage of decoded brain signals for high-impact BCI functionality and novel computer user interfaces.

\item Developed evaluation pipeline to assess neural decoder performance, reliability, and functionality across hundreds of BCI experiments, ensuring production-ready reliability for mission-critical brain interface goals.

\item Optimized ML training workflows for complex neural datasets, reducing model training time by ~80% and enabling faster deployment of novel BCI decoders that restore movement, sight, and speech for patients.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for neural signal validation, reducing decoder errors by 25% while maintaining control accuracy and improving BCI reliability for revolutionary human-AI interaction.

\item Conducted exploratory data analysis on complex neural datasets to identify patterns and drive insights, achieving high model accuracy on time series prediction tasks and communicating results clearly to cross-functional teams of neuroscientists and engineers.
